issues.legal_issue: Uncultivated land held as a landholder remains subject to holding tax when the holder cannot use it for the asserted industrial purpose and the land falls within the statutory definition of land.
material_facts: The company held 277.08 acres as a sirdar and the land was recorded as banjar and remained uncultivated.
The company had acquired the land intending to establish a factory, but its application for permission to use the land for industrial purposes was rejected, and that rejection was affirmed on appeal.
The Board of Revenue directed the levy of holding tax on the land for the relevant assessment years, and the High Court upheld that decision.
The holding exceeded the area below which the Act exempted a land holding from tax.
issues.conclusion: The land was within the Act’s definition of land, and the company could not avoid holding tax by leaving it uncultivated. The appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 2(15) of the U.P. Large Land Holdings Act, 1957 defines land to include uncultivated land held by a landholder as such; section 3 imposes holding tax on a taxable land holding, subject to the area exemption. The Court held that the word “lands” is wide enough to include land whether agricultural or not, relying on Raja Jagannath Baksh Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another, [1963] 1 S.C.R. 220. Under sections 143 and 146 of the U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, permission to use the land for industrial purposes had not been granted, and the holder’s permitted uses were agricultural and related uses. Non-cultivation did not remove the land from the definition or exempt it from tax.

rule.if: tax_assessment_appeal and holding_exceeds_exemption_limit and land_held_as_landholder and land_uncultivated and asserted_industrial_use_not_authorized

predicates.tax_assessment_appeal: The proceeding challenges an assessment or levy of holding tax on a land holding.
predicates.holding_exceeds_exemption_limit: The area of the holding exceeds the threshold below which holding tax is not charged.
predicates.land_held_as_landholder: The person liable for the assessment holds or occupies the land in the capacity of a landholder.
predicates.land_uncultivated: The land has not been brought under cultivation.
predicates.asserted_industrial_use_not_authorized: The holder asserts that the land is held for industrial use, but has not obtained permission to use it for that purpose.

issues.definition: When a holding-tax assessment appeal concerns an above-threshold holding held by a landholder, and the land is uncultivated and its asserted industrial use is unauthorized, the holding remains subject to holding tax.
